title: Data: Partial Parallel Elastic Actuation: A Novel Actuation Paradigm for Mechanical Energy Recycling
authors: Nathan De Smedt | Wesley Roozing | Bram Vanderborght | Tom Verstraten
finding: Eight raw CSV trials from a compliant transmission bench. Three torque transducers, two motor torque channels and shaft/spring position. Actual CSVs have 11 columns; only the first nine are documented. One motor channel is identically zero during backdriving while shaft sensors vary. No verified pre-/post-limit command.

title: Dual-Variable Characterisation
authors: Felipe Ballen Moreno | Pasquale Ferrentino | Milan Amighi | Bram Vanderborght | Tom Verstraten
finding: Eight sampled MAT members distinguish measured interpolated force/displacement and torque/rotation from simulated responses, for four sites on one phantom. Optimizer files reuse measurements on fit-specific grids. The export contains one candidate grid per site and only finite coordinate/response pairs.
